# Jeffrey Aboh

> Personal website of Jeffrey Aboh, a team lead and senior software and AI engineer at Ethion Technologies.

Jeffrey Aboh builds web and mobile products, API services, and AI-enabled experiences. His work combines hands-on full-stack engineering with product engineering, team leadership, and business development.

## Pages

- [Home](https://jeffreyaboh.co.uk/): Overview of Jeffrey Aboh and his featured project, Ethion.
- [Resume](https://jeffreyaboh.co.uk/resume.html): Professional experience, skills, and technologies.
- [Contact](https://jeffreyaboh.co.uk/contact.html): Contact details and social profiles.

## Featured project

- [Ethion Cloud](https://ethion.cloud/): An AI-assisted app-building platform for creating branded Android, iOS, and web/PWA apps.

## Areas of work

Full-stack software engineering, web and mobile application development, API services, AI and LLM integration, AI agents, cloud infrastructure, product engineering, and engineering leadership.
